title: Account token dialog semantics follow-up
classification: Confirmed accessibility-semantic mismatch; visible panel dimensions already matched.

finding.legacy: The visible account panel carries role=dialog.
finding.current_before_fix: The full-screen scrim carried role=dialog and aria-modal=true; the visible panel held the focus trap.
finding.impact: A role-based bounds query selected the scrim rather than the visible dialog panel. This did not establish a visual size difference, but it made the current dialog's accessible boundary broader than the panel users interact with.

change.summary: Moved role=dialog, aria-modal, and the accessible name to the visible panel that contains focus management. The backdrop remains the click-to-dismiss surface.
change.regression_test: frontend/shared/src/Modal.test.tsx asserts the role-bearing element is the panel and backdrop dismissal still works.

limits: Screen-reader and keyboard review in a real browser was not performed.
The R1972 exact-image screenshots and lifecycle data were not regenerated because only dialog semantics changed.
